gen-fs-paquito-satoshi: Paquito's lowercase stands nearly as tall as its capitals, sturdy and warm. Its bowls swell with some weight, while Satoshi, a sans with a soaring x-height, draws each stroke with constant width and stays approachable.
gen-fs-pencerio-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary, modern sans with generous gaps left in its curves. Amulya stays open beneath Pencerio's graceful, tightly fitted calligraphy, a pairing happiest when the text is only a few words.
gen-fs-pencerio-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, leaving generous space between where each curve ends and its stem. Pencerio's graceful, formal script wants just a few words beside it, nothing longer.
gen-fs-pencerio-fs-spline-sans: Pencerio writes in a graceful, formal calligraphic hand with tightly fitted words. Spline Sans, a sans-serif with wide curve gaps and identical weight in every stroke, reads smoothly line after line, though the pair favors lighter text.
gen-fs-pencerio-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable, its constant stripe of ink leaving generous openings in every curve it draws. Formal, graceful script over unvarying ink, pleasant when the reading is brief.
gen-fs-pencerio-lora: Formal flourish, then bookish ease: Pencerio's tight calligraphic hand brings the grace. And Lora, a serif with modest hairline thinning and a welcoming c, brings the literary steadiness for a couple of lines.
gen-fs-pencerio-plus-jakarta-sans: Graceful and formal, Pencerio leans on a tightly fitted calligraphic hand. Plus Jakarta Sans, a monoline sans-serif with curve endings kept well apart, reads modern and precise, agreeable over a brief stretch.
gen-fs-pencerio-space-grotesk: Formal and graceful, Pencerio writes in a tightly fitted calligraphic hand. Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, so the pull is script against monoline, best with few words.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-epunda-slab: Tightly packed, friendly rounds: Pramukh Rounded bunches its glyphs with hardly any gap. Epunda Slab, a dignified serif with tall rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c, keeps paragraph after paragraph open and unhurried.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is literary and dignified, with a tall middle band. Its shallow ascenders and generous e entry keep paragraphs moving smoothly under Pramukh Rounded's friendly, tightly bunched headings.
